name: Shaoxing Wine
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in cooking amounts as alcohol evaporates during cooking, reducing fermentation potential.
preparationTips: Use in stir-fries and braised dishes where alcohol will cook off
Store in cool, dark place after opening
A little goes a long way - start with 1 tablespoon per dish
Can be added early in cooking process to allow alcohol to evaporate
alternatives: Rice vinegar with a pinch of salt
Low-sodium soy sauce for umami depth
pairsWellWith: Bok choy and other Asian greens
nutritionalHighlights: Adds complex umami flavor to dishes
Contains trace minerals from rice fermentation
Low in calories when used in cooking amounts
Alcohol content cooks off in most preparations
